headline: Executive session on impact bargaining with the Springfield Education Association over a cyberattack.
summary: Executive session will cover bargaining strategy with the Springfield Education Association. Votes may be taken, and an open session will then begin the Student Speak Out at 6:00 PM.
items: Vote to enter executive session on impact bargaining with the Springfield Education Association about a cyberattack
location: Springfield City Hall, 36 Court Street 2 FLR, Room 220, Springfield, MA

Special Meeting of the Springfield School Committee 
 
AGENDA OF THE SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
SPECIAL MEETING 
Thursday, November 12, 2026 @ 5:15 PM 
 
LOCATION 
Springfield City Hall 
36 Court Street 2 FLR, Room 220 
Springfield, MA 
 
All meetings may be viewed live in real-time at: 
https://www.youtube.com/@schoolcommitteeSPS/streams 
 
ORDER OF BUSINESS 
I. CALL TO ORDER – SPECIAL MEETING – ROLL CALL 
A. Invocation 
B. Pledge of Allegiance 
II. Vote to enter into executive session in accordance with Mass. G.L. c. 30A, Section 
21(a)(3), to discuss strategy with respect to collective bargaining if an open meeting 
may have a detrimental effect on the bargaining position of the public body and the 
chair so declares – Springfield Education Association, MTA/NEA – Impact 
Bargaining Regarding Cyberattack. 
*Note: Votes may be taken, and the School Committee will reconvene in an open session to 
commence the Student Speak Out at 6:00 PM.
